entities.name: Online Bookstore System
entities.description: An AWS-hosted global online bookstore handling 1 million monthly active users with multi-currency support and secure e-commerce operations, providing catalogue browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and personalized book recommendations.

entities.name: Customers / Shoppers
entities.description: End-users browsing catalogues and purchasing books.

entities.name: Registered Users / Reviewers
entities.description: Authenticated customers writing reviews and ratings.

entities.name: Store Administrators
entities.description: Internal staff managing content and catalogue accuracy.

entities.name: Analytics & Monitoring Platform
entities.description: Datadog/Segment tracking checkout friction and telemetry.

entities.name: Single-Page Application (SPA)
entities.description: Delivers sub-2s page loads on 3G for the SPA hosted globally on AWS CloudFront/S3.

entities.name: API Gateway / Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)
entities.description: Handles request routing, rate limiting, and TLS termination.
entities.technology: AWS API Gateway / NestJS on AWS ECS Fargate

entities.name: Catalog & Search Service
entities.description: Isolates keyword searches for scalable catalogue browsing.

entities.name: Order & Checkout Service
entities.description: Ensures ACID-compliant transactions for carts and orders across multiple regions.

entities.name: Recommendation & Review Service
entities.description: Isolates heavy analytical recommendation and review queries from checkout.
